title: Marketing that is creative on the outside and analytical on the inside
paragraphs: I'm Khajida, a digital marketer with 6+ years of hands-on experience running paid ads, SEO and e-commerce growth for startups, D2C brands and service businesses.
I believe good marketing is simple: understand the customer, make a clear offer, track everything, and keep improving. I work closely with founders and teams so every taka spent is accountable.

highlights.title: ROI-first mindset
highlights.text: Every campaign starts with a measurable goal and a tracking plan.

highlights.title: Data over guesswork
highlights.text: GA4, GTM and Pixel set up properly so decisions are based on facts.

highlights.title: Fast execution
highlights.text: Clear weekly sprints, quick tests and transparent reporting.
